text:
maria: heads-up — saw a hard saturation spike in us-west ~19:02 UTC. queue depth hit ~900, admission rejections jumped, lots of p50->p95 gap. anyone else seeing this?
josh: saw it. grafana: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/cluster?panel=queue_depth -> big bump. logs show prewarm probes didn't result in allocations; pods Pending for ~25-35s.
autoscale-bot: scaled cluster-us-west: gpu-nodes 48 -> 64 (policy: burst-aggressive) at 19:03; some new pods failed to attach to spot pools due to capacity.
kai: my read: warm-pool credit exhaustion + long spin-up on spot. current global_grace_window=120s which is too permissive for these short bursts.
maria: yup — we saw soft-shed engage (drop 30% of requests) then a huge jump when autoscaler finished -> downstream error storms.
olivia: :warning: cost note — shrinking grace window will increase churn and potentially spike spot preemptions. need guardrails.
anand: proposal: add a "spillback" admission path + per-model scale-inhibit TTL to avoid flapping. idea: when region headroom < threshold, admit a bounded soft_rate locally and spill the rest to fallback regions with a token-bucket so we limit cross-region amplification. also attach a per-model inhibit for scale-in to avoid oscillation.
anand: example config snippet:```yaml
admission:
  regional_soft_threshold: 0.75
  spillback_enabled: true
  spillback_policy:
    fallback_region_order: [us-east, eu-west]
    token_bucket:
      capacity: 200
      refill_rate_per_min: 500
  scale_inhibit:
    ttl_seconds: 60
    per_model: true
```
kai: also: add jittered backoff on warm-pool prewarm probes and reduce grace window to 45s but only for high-QPS models (label-based). that should cut the long tail without killing low-volume models.
josh: canary plan? pros: test spillback correctness and cost. propose canary 3% traffic for 2h then 20% for 1h. need alert if spillback_rate > 5% or p95 latency > 250ms.
maria: okay i'll open a PR that wires admission->spillback + canary flags. canary target: 3% for 2h, then 25% for 1h. rollback if p95 > 250ms or RU cost delta > 5% in the canary slice.
autoscale-bot: deployment triggered by maria in infra/admission at 19:05 UTC — canary rollout (3%) started.
olivia: :thumbsup: add a toggle to exclude spot-only nodepools from the canary to avoid noisy preemptions. also track cost per-token delta.
josh: small note — ensure per-model KV cache preload isn't blocked by spillback routing; cache misses across region will wreck p95. allow cache preload for top-20 models before spillback reroute.
maria: noted, i'll add a preload-exempt flag in the PR for top models.
kai: LGTM. target to ship in tonight's maintenance window (22:00 UTC).
anand: i'll assemble a short runbook for SRE: how to abort canary, revert grace window to 120s, and disable spillback token buckets manually.
maria: thanks all — i'll paste PR and dashboard links once ready and tag oncall.
